label: eSputnik (Yespo)
description: Read account, contact field schema, contact cards and broadcast metadata

operations.name: get_account_info
operations.description: Read the protected userEmail and organisationName witness. An orgId is included only if returned; this does not prove access to other operations.

operations.name: get_additional_fields
operations.description: Read the documented additionalFieldsLists structure, including field keys, types, allowed values and validation metadata. No contact values are fetched.

operations.name: search_contacts
operations.description: Read one page from GET /contacts. At least one documented search condition is required locally; this operation does not perform a bulk contact export or establish suppression status.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Read an exact contact ID under the current API key. The card does not return global blacklist or full email subscription status.

operations.name: list_broadcasts
operations.description: Read broadcast metadata, without fetching message content or changing delivery. Full pages indicate only that another page may exist.

operations.name: get_broadcast
operations.description: Read one exact broadcast metadata record. This does not fetch its message, recipients, content or delivery report.
